title: proposal file, version 2: what a reviewed ontology hands to a host's semantic layer, links between records included
description: The file `latence_proposal_writer` writes (YAML; this schema is held against the file as read back). It is written from a host's description of the shape its own proposal tool reads, extended by two kinds of entry; the host's reader is the authority on that shape, and this schema describes only what this writer writes. Every entry names where it goes by a catalog object and a column, and carries the decision it rests on. Nothing else is written: no mark such as `seeded` or `certified_on` exists here, because what would carry one is never written. Version 2 states its version and adds one kind of entry: a link between two records that a person approved (ticket 45). A reader of version 1 refuses it, because version 1 has no `version` key.

version.description: The file's version. Absent in version 1.

source.description: The kind of source the entries come from.

origin.description: The decision the entry rests on: the element decided (its id in the export), what it stated when it was decided (its claim), and who approved it on which day.

at.description: The day of the decision, an ISO date.

spellings_entry.description: Two values of a value set that a reviewer called the same: the value kept and its other spellings.

object.description: A catalog object that holds the value set, as `<schema>.<table>`.

value.description: The value kept: the one more rows carry.

names_entry.description: The names of a master list's records, by the record's key.

values.description: Key of a record -> its name.

record.description: A record of a catalog object: the object, its key column, the record's key and its own name there.

links_entry.description: Two records a person decided are one organisation (or one thing): never a link the machine accepted alone, never one that holds a seeded record.
